fact: The Circle of the Masters is located beyond the Garden of Welcome and is dominated by a towering mushroom.
source_quote: Beyond the Garden of Welcome stands the Circle of the Masters, dominated by a towering mushroom.
subject: Circle of the Masters

fact: The remaining heads planted in the garden begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.
source_quote: The remaining heads planted in the garden begin to croak and groan, joining the horrible song.
subject: victims joining the song

fact: Thorin recognizes a musical sympathy between the sound in the cavern and the discordant cacophony he perceived in Yrberop's mind.
source_quote: Thorin recognizes a musical sympathy between this sound and the discordant cacophony he perceived in Yrberop's mind.
subject: Thorin

fact: Yrberop's mind contained a discordant cacophony that Thorin perceived.
source_quote: the discordant cacophony he perceived in Yrberop's mind
subject: Yrberop

fact: Thorin observes that the party's reluctance to approach is similar to audience members in a horror film shouting at the characters not to continue.
source_quote: Thorin observing that an audience watching a horror film would be shouting at them not to continue
subject: Thorin

fact: A parade of vaguely humanoid creatures covered in luminescent lichen and tumescent growths on decaying flesh appears through the mist.
source_quote: Through the mist, the party observes a parade of vaguely humanoid creatures covered in luminescent lichen and tumescent growths on decaying flesh.
subject: humanoid creatures

fact: The voices of the humanoid creatures stab into the party's minds and sound equally insane and gleeful.
source_quote: Their voices stab into the party's minds and sound equally insane and gleeful.
subject: humanoid creatures

fact: A telepathic chant echoes in the party's minds announcing the wedding of Zuggtmoy to Araumycos.
source_quote: A telepathic chant echoes in their minds, announcing the wedding of Zuggtmoy to Araumycos.
subject: telepathic chant

fact: Zuggtmoy is described as the Demon Queen of Fungi and the Lady of Decay.
source_quote: Zuggtmoy herself — the Demon Queen of Fungi, the Lady of Decay
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: Araumycos is the groom in the wedding hymn celebrating the union with Zuggtmoy.
source_quote: a wedding hymn celebrating the union of Zuggtmoy and Araumycos
subject: Araumycos

fact: The wedding hymn promises that Zuggtmoy's joyous spores will spread and that the bride and groom will become one 'till death do part'.
source_quote: promising that her joyous spores would spread to all the world below and above... becoming one till death do part
subject: wedding hymn

fact: The party jokes about whether they are wedding crashers, wedding gifts, guests, or the feast.
source_quote: The party jokes about whether they are wedding crashers, wedding gifts, guests, or the feast.
subject: party banter

fact: Zuggtmoy's bridesmaids emerge from the mist.
source_quote: Zuggtmoy's bridesmaids emerge from the mist.
subject: Zuggtmoy's bridesmaids

fact: The party confirms that Zuggtmoy is the same demon lady Thorin previously encountered.
source_quote: The party confirms that she is the same demon lady Thorin previously encountered.
subject: Zuggtmoy

fact: The session ends with Zuggtmoy and her procession walking toward the party.
source_quote: The session ends with Zuggtmoy and her procession walking toward the party.
subject: procession advances
